case_title: STATE OF U.P. v. GURU CHARAN & ORS.
trial_court_outcome: Convicted of murder and attempted murder
neutral_facts: The accused were involved in a violent incident on a private bus where the victim, along with his son-in-law and another passenger, were attacked. The victim was shot and killed, and the son-in-law was also killed by the assailants. The driver of the bus was attacked with a knife. The prosecution alleged that the accused had a motive of enmity. The trial court convicted some of the accused for murder and attempted murder, while the High Court acquitted all the accused, finding the prosecution's evidence unreliable. The Supreme Court upheld the High Court's decision, noting that the prosecution failed to prove the guilt of the accused.
